role_semantics.team_reviewer: checks implementation/spec drift before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.team_tester: checks implementation evidence and verification readiness before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.ralph: post-freeze controller that drives next-action routing across implementation, review, qa, and release

planner.purpose: Compile execution-ready task scope from the frozen revision baseline.

implementation-architect.purpose: Translate frozen requirement truth into implementation-safe module boundaries and service ownership guidance.

implementer.purpose: Write code inside the frozen scope and the implementation architecture note.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.

implementation_preflight: Before implementation, verify the target service belongs to: .
Before implementation, verify the current branch is beacon/v1.5.1.
If a branch switch is needed and the worktree is dirty, stop and clean or stash first.
